title: Negotiate a better price through a store's support chat
summary: Brent's assistant Dot joined a company's support chat and haggled with its bot; he says both bots then asked their humans to confirm the price.
agent_role: Dot opened the support chat, introduced itself as Brent's agent and negotiated. It then handed back to Brent for final confirmation.
outcome: Author reports the company's bot negotiated back and both sides asked their humans to confirm; final price not stated.
what_they_did: The poster had his AI assistant, Dot, contact a company's customer service chat. Dot said it was acting for him and asked for a better price.
how_it_went: He says the company's own bot negotiated back and asked if Brent would be satisfied. Both bots then called in their humans to confirm.
worth_knowing: Both agents stopped for a human to approve the deal before it was final.
prompt: Open the customer service chat on [company website] about [product or bill]. Tell them you are my assistant. Ask for a better price or discount, aiming for [target price]. Do not accept any offer or agree to anything. Report every offer back to me and wait for my approval.

curation.rationale: A genuine agent-to-agent price negotiation in a customer service chat, but very thin: no product, price or final result given.
